chapter.verse: Tua mite tawh ka kikhen khit uh ciangin teembaw tungah tuangin Kos khua tang takin ka tung uh a, a zingsang ciangin Rodes tuikulhah tungin tua khua panin Patara khua ka tung uh hi.
Foenisia gamah a pai ding teembaw khat ka muh uh ciangin tuangin ka pai uh hi.
Saipras tuikulh ka muh uh ciangin a tak lamah pai-in Siria gam galkahin Tai-ar khua-ah ka khawl uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, teembaw in tua khua-ah a van puak teng suahkhia ding ahi hi.
Tua lai-ah nungzuite ka muh uh ciangin ni sagih tawntung ka tam uh hi. Paul in Jerusalem khua ah pai lo dingin amaute in Kha Siangtho theihsakna tawh a gen uh hi.
Ni sagih khit ciangin ka paikik uh a, nungzuite khempeuh in, a zite a tate uh tawh khua nawlah kote hong kha uh a, tuipi gei-ah khukdin’in thu ka nget khit uh ciangin,
khat-le-khat mangpha ka kikhak khit uh ciangin teembaw tungah ka kahto uh a, amaute a ciahkik uh hi.
Tai-ar khua pan Tolemias khua-ah ka tun’ uh ciangin teembaw tawh paina a om nawn kei hi. Tua khua-a om u leh naute ka hopih uh a, ni khat ka tam khit uh ciangin,
zingsang ciangin paikikin Kaisaria khua-ah ka tung uh a, Sagihte laka khat ahi thuhilhsia Filip, innah tungin ka om uh hi.
Tua pa in thuhilh thei tanu li a nei hi.
Tua innah sawtpi ka om lai takin Agabas min nei kamsangpa khat in Judah gam panin hong paisuk hi.

Tua pa in kote kiangah hong tung a, Paul’ kawnggak la-in, a khut a khe a hen khit ciangin, “Hih kawnggak neipa Jerusalem khua-ah a om Judah mite in hih bangin henin, Gentailte’ khut tungah a pia ding uh hi,’ ci-in Kha Siangtho in hong ci hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu ka zak uh ciangin kote leh tua khua-ah a om mite in, “Jerusalem khua-ah pai kei in,” ci-in Paul ka thuum uh hi.
Paul in zong, “Bang dingin kapin ka lungsim kizan nading na hih uh hiam? Topa Zeisu’ min hangin Jerusalem khua-ah kihen tham loin, sihna nangawn thuak dingin ka omkhol hi,” a ci hi.
Ka zolna uh hong man’ loh ciangin kote in, “Topa’ deih bangin hi ta hen,” ci-in zol loin ka om uh hi.
Tua nung ciangin ka vante uh la-in Jerusalem khua-ah ka paito uh hi.
Kote Kaisaria khua nungzuite kimkhat in hong zui uh hi. Kote zin tun’ nading Manason min nei Saipras gam mi, nungzui a suah zawh a sawt zo, thu-um mipa’ innah hong kha uh hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah ka tun’ uh ciangin ute naute in lungdamna tawh hong tungsak uh hi.
A zing ciangin Paul tawh Jeim kiangah ka tumkhawm uh a, upate khempeuh a kikhawm uh hi.
Paul in tua mite a hopih khit ciangin ama thuhilh nasepna hanga Pasian in Gentailte tungah ahihna thu khempeuh khat nungah khat a gen hi.
Amaute in a zak uh ciangin Pasian’ min a phat uh hi. Paul kiangah zong, “Sanggam aw, thu-um Judah mi then bangzah a om na thei hi. Tua mite khempeuh in Thukham hahkatin a zui uh hi.
Gentailte lakah a om Judah mite khempeuh in amaute’ tate vun atsak lo tham loin ngeina tang loin Moses thu nusia dingin na hilh hi ci-in hih mite in a za zo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bang ci hih ding na hi hiam?
Na tun’na thu a za ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka cih uh mah bangin na hih ta in. Thu kiciamsa mi li ka nei uh hi.

Tua mite la in la, amaute tawh na kisiangtho sak in la, amaute a sam met nadingin dangka na sik ding hi. Tua bang na hih leh, mi khempeuh in nangma thu a zak uh ahi lo thu hi a, Thukham thu tangin khial loin na om hi cih a thei ding uh hi.
Thu-um Gentailte ahih uh leh, milim biakna tawh, si tawh, gawl meeka kithat sa tawh, numei tawh khialhna tawh tan’ nadingin thu khenin lai ka gelh zo uh hi,” ci-in amaute in a gen uh hi.

Tua ciangin Paul in tua mite paipih a, zingsang ciangin amaute tawh a kisian’thosak khit ciangin biakna innpi sungah pai-in, tuate khempeuh ading biakna a piak khit dongin, kisian’thosakna ni a cing sak hi.
Tua ni sagih a cin’ dek tak ciangin Asia gam Judah mite in biakna innpi-ah Paul a muh uh ciangin,

mi honpite hansuahin, “Israel mite aw, hong huh un! Hih pa in ei mi pawlte ahi zongin, Thukhamna ahi zongin, hih mun ahi zongin, a kituak loin bawl a, mun khempeuh ah mi vekpi kiangah thu a hilh hi. Tua tham loin Grik mite biakna innpi sungah lut sakin, hih mun siangtho a nin sak hi,” ci-in a man uh hi.

Bang hangin hih bangin ahih uh hiam i cih leh, a beisa hun lai-inah Paul leh Trofimas min nei Efesa khua mipa khua sungah a omkhawm a mu zo uh a, Paul in tua mipa biakna innpi sungah a tumsak hi ci-in a um uh hi.
Khuazangin kigamlum a, mi tampite tai-in kikhawm uh a, Paul a mat khit uh ciangin biakna innpi sung pan a kaihkhiat khit uh ciangin kong a khak kik uh hi.
Amaute in Paul that ding a kisak lai takun, Jerusalem khuazang gamlumin a om uh galkap mangpa kiangah kam a tun’ ciangin,
galkapte leh bute a manlangin kisam a, tua mite kiangah a taisuk uh hi. Amaute in galkap mangpa leh galkapte a muh uh ciangin, Paul sat nawn lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in va nai a, Paul a mat khit ciangin sikkhau nih tawh hen ding thu a piak khit ciangin, “Hih mi kua mi ahi hiam? Bang hih khial ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Mi kimkhat in kam khat a kiko uh hi, kimkhat in kam khat a kiko uh hi. Mangpa in gamlumna hangin a tel takpi-in thei zo lo ahih ciangin galkap innah Paul a kipaipih nading thu a pia hi.
Kahlei-ah a tun’ ciangin mite heh mahmah uh ahih ciangin, galkapte in Paul domin a pua uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mi honpite in a nung zui-in, “Amah that ni,” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Paul in galkap’ inn sungah a tum lai takin, “Kam khat kong gen thei ding hiam?” ci-in galkap mangpa kiangah a dot ciangin, “Nang Grik pau siam na hi hiam?
Nang in, nidang lai-inah mi suam ding hansuahin, a suamte tuili gampa lakah a paipih Izipt mi hilo na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Paul in zong, “Kilikia gam Tarsus khua-a suak, Judah mi ka hi hi. Kei teen’na in khua gina lo ahi kei hi. Hih mite kiangah thu ka gen theih na’ngin thu hong pia in cih kong thuum hi,” a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in thu a piak ciangin Paul in kahlei tungah ding-in a khut zanin mite kham a, amaute in a daih khit uh ciangin Hebru pau-in:
